'''Ookbat''' was the site of a botched mission by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin|Tinian I'att]] and [[Chenlambec]] the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. A warren-like network of dank caves existed under the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface.
